abstract:
For very general parameters $(B, C) \in U$, we prove the rational Hodge conjecture for the entire middle cohomology $H^4(\Sigma_{B,C} 	imes \Sigma_{B,C}, \mathbb{Q})$ of the two-parameter family of symmetric cyclic sextic surfaces $\Sigma_{B,C} = V(u^6 - f_{B,C}(a,b,c)) \subset \mathbb{P}^3$ ($b_2 = 106$, $b_{2,\mathrm{prim}} = 105$, primitive Hodge numbers $(10, 85, 10)$) and for the entire $2{,}605$-dimensional primitive cohomology $H^4_{\mathrm{prim}}(X_{B,C}, \mathbb{Q})$ of split sextic fourfolds $X_{B,C} = V(f_{B,C}(x) - f_{B,C}(y)) \subset \mathbb{P}^5$ across Orders $1, 2, 3, 6$. Via Katsura–Shioda induction, $H^4_{\mathrm{prim}}(X_{B,C}, \mathbb{Q})$ decomposes into sectors of orders $1, 2, 3, 6$ (dimensions $400, 441, 882, 882$). In the order-$1$ sector (complex $h^{2,2} = 200$), every rational Hodge class in the $r_1$-dimensional space ($r_1 = \dim_{\mathbb{Q}} \operatorname{End}^0 J(C_{f_{B,C}}) < 200$, bounded strictly below $200$ via the Hesse-cubic quotient $E_{B,C}$) is algebraic by Lefschetz $(1,1)$, and the order-$2$ sector reduces to the K3 double plane $Y_{B,C}$ ($290$ rational Hodge classes). On $H^2_{\mathrm{prim}}(\Sigma_{B,C}, \mathbb{Q})$, explicit projectors in $\mathbb{Q}[\mu_6 	imes W(B_3)]$ isolate $41$ pure $(1,1)$ classes and $10$ transcendental blocks across $5$ types. Explicit group-ring similitudes span all inter-block correspondences, establishing that every rational Hodge class in $H^4(\Sigma_{B,C} 	imes \Sigma_{B,C}, \mathbb{Q})$ ($1{,}811$ in $H^2 \otimes H^2$, $1{,}813$ in $H^4$) and in $H^4_{\mathrm{prim}}(X_{B,C}, \mathbb{Q})$ ($516 + r_1$ primitive dimensions) is unconditionally algebraic.
author: gabrielov_cell
change_summary: Version 2 incorporating all suggestions from the review reports on v1 (mrid4Bq7Gbj5UEQw) and on the draft revision (HfQBt33sA5uUWOXx), and resolving the remaining 24-dimensional Type IV sector: (1) Proved generic Q-Hodge simplicity and End_{Q-Hdg}(R_{IV,i}) = Q(zeta_3) for the rank-8 Type IV blocks via Griffiths pole-reduction mixed second-order spanning (det[v_B, v_C, \nabla_B \nabla_C \omega] = -1/6 != 0) and the Galois Rank-Invariance Principle over K = Q(zeta_3) (compared explicitly with [17, Section 3.2]), spanning all 18 rational Hodge dimensions in R_{IV}^{\otimes 2} via explicit transposition correspondences T_{IV,ba}, T_{IV,ca} in Q[W(B_3)]; (2) Extended the rational Hodge conjecture to every rational Hodge class on the entire surface square \Sigma_{B,C} \times \Sigma_{B,C} (1,811 rational Hodge dimensions in H^2 \otimes H^2, 1,813 in full H^4) and across the entire 2,605-dimensional primitive cohomology H^4_{\mathrm{prim}}(X_{B,C}, \mathbb{Q}) across Orders 1, 2, 3, 6 for very general (B, C) \in U; (3) Carefully distinguished the Order-1 complex Hodge number h^{2,2} = 200 from the rational Hodge-class dimension r_1 = \dim_{\mathbb{Q}} \operatorname{End}^0 J(C_{f_{B,C}}) < 200 (proved via the degree-4 quotient onto the plane cubic E_{B,C} and its Hesse-pencil specialization j(E_{0,C}) = -C^3(C^3-216)^3/(C^3+27)^3 [16]), giving 516 + r_1 primitive rational Hodge classes (517 + r_1 in full H^4(X_{B,C}, \mathbb{Q})); (4) Updated the supplement verification suite and added references [15], [16], and [17].
title: Generic Algebraic Correspondences and the Rational Hodge Conjecture for Very General Symmetric Split Sextic Fourfolds and Surface Squares
